etsy.title: npm Poster, rm -rf node_modules Joke Print, Funny Programmer Wall Art, Web Developer Gift
etsy.description:
A funny npm poster for the universal fix: rm -rf node_modules, then npm install, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: No npm or node_modules poster surfaced on Etsy; Node.js results are stickers and a sticker pack that includes npm, so the joke print has little direct competition.
Generic programmer-humor posters lean on 'turn it off and on again' and bug jokes; package-manager humor is an open angle.
Cheap digital downloads crowd the programmer-poster results; physical prints sit noticeably higher in price.
Amazon npm humor is apparel (an 'npm install pizza' hoodie), not wall art.
Amazon poster titles stack 'wall decor', 'unframed', and 'gifts for coders and programmers'.

research.notes: Listing pages were not fetched (network allow-list); evidence is from Etsy/Amazon search results only. 'npm poster' is not an Etsy /market page; it was chosen because npm is printed on the artwork and the niche is empty, while generic phrases (programmer poster, developer wall art) carry the broader searches. 'Node.js' kept out of title/tags because the poster does not print it. No priceRange: no comparable physical prices seen.
